description: HUD provides flexible Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) funds to help cities, counties and states recover from Presidentially declared disasters, and its HUD Exchange pages gather the programme's grantee and funding information. They let users find grantees and contacts, see awards and allocations, and open grantees' reports, action plans and project descriptions, with active disaster grants listed; grantees report through the Disaster Recovery Grant Reporting (DRGR) system, and related programmes include CDBG Mitigation (CDBG-MIT), the National Disaster Resilience competition and Rebuild by Design. The pages also carry the Federal Register notices, the Consolidated and Universal Notices and guidance that govern the funds, plus low- and moderate-income data and income limits used to target them. Coverage: U.S. grantees of disaster recovery appropriations. Access: free web pages and downloadable reports. Licence: U.S. government information. Caveats: data are spread across many reports and plans, not one tidy dataset. Simulation uses are recovery funding amounts and timelines for housing and community recovery models. Related records: FEMA Individuals and Households Program registrations.
